description: guard hooks. Logic lives in `scripts/guard_hook.py`; see `dev/design.md` for the design.

hooks.description: Name the file this turn's answer is written to, so the answer is a document the user can be handed and an audit can still correct. Silent when every agent is off, when the session is muted, and on guard's own control commands. guard keeps no copy of the prompt.

Deny a search rooted at the filesystem root — `find /`, `grep -r /`, `rg /` and the `fd`/`ag`/`ack`/`locate` equivalents, a `/`-anchored glob, or a Grep/Glob call whose `path` is `/`. Classifies the tool ARGUMENT and never the caller, so it ignores the agent switches and the mute. Silent for every other call, and fails open on a command it cannot parse.

When the user APPROVES a plan, hold it before it is built until it has been through the plan audit, and again whenever it is revised afterwards. Choosing "tell Claude what to change" runs no tool, so this never fires on feedback. Silent while the session has plan audits muted (`guard-plan off`, the default).

Record a source file, an agent instruction file, or a saved reference written this turn (for a comment-corrector, agents-md-auditor or ext-docs-auditor dispatch) — a subagent's writes included — and require a file saved inside the refs dir to be listed in the refs index (AGENTS.md).

Record the finished turn as the target an audit resolves to, and fill in its answer file if the turn left it empty. Recommends no audit: the turn block names the turn id, the answer file, the translation file and the closeout, and forbids routing the turn unasked — the user runs /guard:audit-turn when they want one. Still names comment-corrector / agents-md-auditor over the files the turn edited, and ext-docs-auditor over anything it wrote under the refs dir, since those conditions are file lists rather than judgments.

Sweep guard state and turn records past the retention window, export GUARD_PROJECT_DIR and GUARD_REFS_DIR, and state the refs rule as session context — plus, when any agent is on, the turn closeout path and the audit commands the user invokes.

When /clear ends a session, hand its session switches to the session replacing it. Matched on `clear` only: every other reason ends a session that is not being replaced. Writes nothing when both switches are muted.
